observed.interpretation: The affected captures combine updated UMG layout with an almost unchanged previous 3D pose. Minor differences within the old world ROI are consistent with temporal shading; it is not byte-identical.

source_evidence.finding: Screenshot delegates to FSlateApplication::TakeScreenshot; it does not request a new game-world render.

TakeScreenshot prepares a readback and calls PrivateDrawWindows. PrivateDrawWindows also performs DrawPrepass at line1462; this redraw can observe fresh widget state outside the normal scene-render phase.
OnPaint emits the viewport draw element from the viewport interface's existing texture, then paints widget children.
FSceneViewport::Paint manages paint scope/size; it does not call the game viewport Draw. GetViewportRenderTargetTexture at line1595 returns the buffered Slate handle/render-thread texture.
SetScrollOffset changes DesiredScrollOffset and invalidates layout. Tick at line886 computes PhysicalOffset at line930; OnArrangeChildren at line174 uses it.
PlayerController tick group defaults to TG_PrePhysics. Current owned BP has one PC EventTick calling UpdateStage; WBP EventTick no longer drives it.
Transform propagation updates world bounds/children and marks the render transform dirty at line1009.
BeginRenderingViewFamilies sends all end-of-frame updates at line5380, explicitly guaranteeing current render proxies before starting the normal scene render.

inference: A forced Slate-only redraw between game-state update and the next viewport render is the leading explanation. These MCP screenshots alone do not prove the same mismatch reaches a normally presented game frame. Runtime coherence is not yet declared verified.
bounded_next_check: Root queues engine Shot SHOWUI for ProcessScreenShots in the normal viewport render path, or records actual OS-presented frames. Compare the same two transitions. Do not delay or double-update Blueprint layout merely to compensate for the screenshot tool.
fallback_only_if_presented_frame_control: Check skeletal component tick prerequisites relative to PC and actual scene/UI frame stamps before changing tick group; root transforms already have the engine end-of-frame flush guarantee. No broad UpdateStage rewrite is currently justified.
